method.prerequisites: Guide tasks assume installation and the native CSS entry unless they teach setup. Installation pages require the named host and its package manager. Reference assumes the relevant Guide concept; Blog links its complete setup.
method.reading: Each authored article and local include was read. Generated lookup pages were read individually, including prose, examples, ordered values and consumers; public compiler fixtures check generated CSS independently.
method.visual: Every URL has six browser profiles (390/768/1280 × light/dark). Openings were inspected individually in readable captures; figures and interactive specimens receive additional checks. Capture success alone is not editorial approval.
method.portable: Reference, search, Markdown and llms use the same content owners. The historical 359-page report is retained as history, not current coverage.

limitations: Native Angular/.NET/CMS/Rails/Laravel/Svelte/Storybook hosts were not all executed end to end. Their authored instructions, public setup/source contracts, links and six-profile article rendering were reviewed. React Router/TanStack root tests cover Vite client/SSR imports, not their framework CLIs.
Browser coverage is Chromium. It does not certify every browser implementation or remote CDN release.
The global exact CSS snapshot also covers unrelated homepage work. Its existing manifest mismatch was not accepted by regenerating the baseline.
